overclaims: A contemporaneous paper identifies shortcomings in a US AI audit requirement, but there is no evidence that Vance knew or relied on it.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, the 'arguably' hedge, the axis, the outcome (unresolved) and the not-applicable horizon all match. The rationale says outright that 'there is no evidence' Vance knew of the paper. The record only says the search found no link, and e2 says 'the record does not show'. That absolute wording repeats the has/presented confusion this case is built around. Suggested fix: 'the reviewed record does not show that Vance knew or relied on it.' Citations copy the frozen items correctly. However, e2's arXiv ID (2501) suggests a January 2025 posting, not 2024-12-13. Either date is before Feb 11, 2025, so it's minor.
